mapper.sql: t.id, t.project_name, t.category, t.organizer, t.organizer_type, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.location, t.duration_note, t.recruit_limit, t.submit_user_id, t.review_user_id, t.review_time, t.reject_reason, t.status, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.real_name, ''), su.nickname, su.username) AS submit_user_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ru.real_name, ''), ru.nickname, ru.username) AS review_user_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_enrollment e WHERE e.project_id = t.id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status != 'cancelled') AS enrolled_count

FROM volunteer_project t LEFT JOIN users su ON su.id = t.submit_user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users ru ON ru.id = t.review_user_id AND ru.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN student_profile ssp ON ssp.user_id = t.submit_user_id AND ssp.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (t.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.organizer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_project (project_name, category, organizer, organizer_type, start_time, end_time, location, duration_note, recruit_limit, submit_user_id, review_user_id, review_time, reject_reason, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{category}, #{organizer}, #{organizerType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{durationNote}, #{recruitLimit}, #{submitUserId}, #{reviewUserId}, #{reviewTime}, #{rejectReason}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_project SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_project t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status}
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_project t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
